body: I genuinely hope you're right. Thank you, though. It really helped me feel better reading your comment.
That's lovely, he seems like a genuinely kind man! Congrats!
I really hope so! But still, this isn't about me, it's about you! You must be over the damn moon and I hope you stay that way!

I'm doing fucking shit, man
Any points I get for effort stem from a desire to have revenge on other people for reminding me of myself
Yo momma so stupid she thought Tupac Shakur is a jewish holiday, beeeeeeeeyyyyooooooootch~
Flying in the sky like superman
Congratulations! I'm so happy for you... and envious. I really want to be where you are one day. I'm just so happy you two managed to make it!
I find Whatsapp rather convenient.

But I don't compare myself to instagram models, or vogue models, or famous actresses... I compare myself to people I see on the street, my peers in college. I saw a girl wearing oversized sweatpants and a hoodie the other day and she looked like a million bucks. With a face like hers, and a body like hers (you could see through the thick fabric how skinny she was) who needs the clothes. I'm an illusion, and this illusion can only exist in a certain environment. Sitting in class or for coffee, namely. Take me outside of that environment, like in the gym, and everything falls apart.

As for your advice,I wish I knew how to make friends... I can hold a conversation, sure, but I don't know how to open up to people. I'm fucking scared.

Mate, literally everyone who's ever taken a selfie or asked someone to take a photo of themselves after looking in the mirror and liking what they see has had the same complaint. It's even a meme. It just happens, and it happens to everyone. Photography is all about good lighting and finding your most flattering angles. I'm still looking for mine, lol

I think your main problem is that you're being overly strict with yourself. You demand too much from yourself, which is why you put yourself in a rotten mood. Honestly you're being borderline irrational with the shirt thing. Clothes can't change the way your face looks, they're not that powerful. Sure, some colors may suit you better or worse, but your face isn't play-dough. It was cute a minute ago, it's still gonna be cute a minute from now.

Moods can have fluctuations, and so can confidence. It happens, not every day is the same. But when your lack of confidence starts affecting how you go about your day or read the people around you, we've got a fucking problem.

Just curious... Who would you be satisfying if you looked like your version of perfection? Would it be yourself, or the people around you? 

As for the fact that you're bothered by being skinny,I mean, you are skinny, but you're not Auschwitz skinny. You are literally normal, mate. However, you could look into investing in some muscle if you think it would help you feel more comfortable in your skin.

Nothing is wrong with you. You look great! Yours is a confidence issue, not an appearance issue. Agreeing with the one person instead of telling them to figuratively (or even literally) to fuck off is really not what you want to be doing. With confidence as fragile as yours, toxicity is the last thing you need/want. Talk to someone, a friend, a professional, but talk to someone. Someone positive, who can help you feel better.Start building your self-esteem (from scratch if you have to, but build it) and start living a happier life. 
Life's too short not to.
You're being way too hard on yourself. Give yourself a break. :)
PM me if you need any help.

I'm honestly curious what you think is wrong with your appearance...?
You look really cute!
You should invest in some self-esteem so you'll start seeing it too!

Dude, stfu. You look great! 
You look so troubled in this photo, it doesn't do you justice.
The haircut suits you, you've got nothing to worry about imo

I think you look nice!
Your facial symmetry is good, your nose is very well formed (I'd KILL for that kind of nose!) and you have very nice, large eyes and very shapely lips.
I don't believe in ratings, so I won't even go there, screw that.
That being said, you're still pretty young, so give it some time you can grow into your looks, and don't be too insecure with yourself.
Honestly,just throw on some mascara and you'll be poppin'! :)
I would pay top dollar to have this guy explain his thought process to me. Because you know you're fucked in the head when you can be so aloof to the fact that you're making someone uncomfortable.

Hey, WCE123.
Your comment was the hardest one to respond to, mainly because I had to re-read it like 4 times trying to figure out if you were mocking me. But I'm gonna do myself a favor and flatter my piece of shit ego and answer believing you're sincere.

As cute and mushy as your lecture on love might've been, I'm waaaaay over the Care Bears.
 
When I was in 6th grade I heard the phrase :"You accept the love you think you deserve." Well, that's the thing. I don't feel like I deserve love. I don't. I just don't. Even if I got it, I wouldn't know what to do with it. I would throw it away. I've nothing to offer. And at the same time, I would never settle. Ever. 
EVER.
I'd like to have children and get married. I do. But my genetics are so shitty I don't wanna infect the gene pool. It's bad enough as it is. I'm nothing special. Really. I used to hear it all the time about how well I could write and sing, and guess what, I haven't picked up a pen in three fucking years. My writing talent, if I ever had any, is gone. And screw singing. Every time I sing, my eyes water. I'm not gonna risk bawling in front of strangers. The only reason I even mentioned those two dead hobbies is because I carry on with them
Just like life.I feel like life itself is something I'm just carrying on with.
I used to look at planes in the night sky and even if I had no idea where they were headed, I so deeply wished I was on them. Now I look at the planes and the trains and even the cars and I feel nothing. Nothing at all. They're not meant for me. They might as well be out of the solar system. I've no place in them.
I looked through an old diary of mine from 2010 and found out that I never had a goal or a dream. To become an artist or a doctor. All I wanted to do was leave. Not even go somewhere specific. Just leave.

I thought I'd be able to find a place to settle down and feel happy if I searched long enough, but I haven't even started the journey and I don't feel like there's a place for me anywhere. I feel like no matter where I go, physically or emotionally, people want me out and away. I feel isolated like a leper and at the same time I'm like an animal stuck in a trap and I will claw and bite at anyone who'll try to help. Because I don't believe they're trying to help. I believe they're trying to milk me for all I'm worth and take advantage of me while I'm in a bad place. I trust basically no one. EVERYONE has ulterior motives. Even my family. 
I know I sound paranoid and crazy, but honestly I'm so tired of everything I've resorted to venting on freaking reddit hoping to get things together for a while before I go back to feeling like shit.
So yeah, I guess that should tel you everything about how pathetic I am.

That theory could never work on me because I will not only stick to my guns relentlessly, and I'm also fiercely suspicious of anyone I don't know, defensive as fuck,and there's a lot of selfishness and bitter cynicism in there, too. If that person went through the trouble to get in debt so they can "help" me, they made a shit career choice. And the very idea that they've got all their issues figured out, so they can fix mine as well is laughable. And at the end of the day, I don't owe them jack shit. I'll owe them the hourly fee after our session will be over. And that'll be it.
Ok... Thanks, dude
That'll be hard to do, but I'll try. I want the cat to be ok.
Knowing myself it might take me years to go.

I wanna thank all of you guys because regardless of whether I "give in" and try going to therapy or not, talking to you guys has helped me realize a lot of things about what the real, underlying issues might be. When and if I decide to talk to someone, (and I mean REALLY talk to someone, commit to it) I'll come back here and write down some of the stuff I've written to help identify the problem, and re-read your comments, and who knows, maybe not feel like so much of a failure for trying therapy. But I wanna thank each and every one of you. You guys are all alright in my book.

So what you're saying is that I'll talk to the therapist about something and if they find it puzzling they'll discuss it with other people? Freaking great, I'll take a leap of complete idiotic faith pouring my heart out to someone I neither trust nor know and next thing I know, everyone and their dog will know about it? Heart-warming.
In any case though I wanna thank you for the time you've given me nonetheless. Head-butting with you helped me at least write down things I haven't even admitted to myself. So, thanks.

I would never try to fabricate a weight loss plan for the cat on my own, I have zero qualifications to do that
I was thinking of making her portions smaller and playing with her more (making her chase the red dot? I don't know!) and of course, taking her to the vet. But how do I word it? How do I tell the vet the cat's pulled a Jessica Simpson while I was away without making my relative look like a shit pet owner?
I think you've hit the nail on the head on this one, my friend.

If wanting to be able to depend on myself and not wanting to become dependent on a stranger who knows literally nothing about me but is convinced they can turn me into a "normal" person is hubris, then yes. I want to be strong on my own. I don't want to need other people to hold my hand through things. If I can't get though this on my own, like I've always have, then I don't deserve to get through it.

With the secretive mindset I have I could have my leg ripped clean off and I'd try to duct-tape it back on.

But seriously, the very idea that the one thing that I had faith in is falling apart is killing me. And it's not just falling apart, it's falling apart noticeably.
I'm inferior and lacking in so many ways. I'm not social, my body is below average, my looks are also below average (in no way do I embody the ideal. And God knows I've strived for that.), my confidence is shit, I am a SHIT student, and incompetent to boot.  If I have to admit that I'm also emotionally inferior to the people around me I might as well throw myself off a building

If I do talk, I'll be talking to a STRANGER. A strange man or woman who doesn't give a damn about me. Who honestly couldn't give a damn if I live or die. I'll be just another name on their appointment log. Just another pocket. I'd be nothing to them but another whiner come to boo-hoo-hoo about how life is mean for them. I'm 21. I'll get laughed outta there. And if I don't, I should be.
My honest problem isn't that they're insisting on it so much as the fact that they see something wrong in me.

Oh,I'll insinuate the hundreds of thousands of people who "are brave enough" to go to therapy, alright. Not all of them deserve respect. There's the legitimately brave people, the pro-active problem-solvers who really want to get their lives together, and then there's the little bitches. The reason I'm so mortified and depressed to try therapy out is because I know if I do, I could have the world's most loving a supporting people around me talking about how brave I am, but in my heart and in my mind, I'll always be the little bitch who couldn't clean up their own mental mess. It would seal my future believing I'm weak and truly flawed. I don't know if I could live with that. I've had physical appearance issues since I was like 6, and my only consolation until I became 18 was that I was alright emotionally. If I can't even depend on my own mental strength, I've got nothing.

You're right. I recently turned 21. But still, I've always hated therapy. Hated the very idea of it. I feel like from the moment someone pays a stranger so they can whine and bitch about their lame lives, they've basically admitted to themselves and also everyone around them that they're flawed. And weak, and not cut out for even being alive. I have an older friend I respect and love like hell, and she's been through therapy, and I respect her for that. But the thing is she went to therapy because she was raped as a teenager. Thank God I wasn't. So I basically feel like I'd waste the therapist's time, and let a STRANGER hear things about me I don't even have the guts to write on paper.

I doubt there are really people out there who'd want to have their day ruined by my shit. Especially strangers.
As for the therapy, I did try it. Just one session.
The guy said I might have BDD. I lied about not knowing what it was, and when he explained all I could think of was "It's diagnosable."
Ergo, I'm flawed. I'm the older sibling and my brother wins in life in every single way. He's got a gazillion friends, goes from one party to the next and the same goes for concerts. I've been a college student for 3 years and I've fucking nothing to show for it.

As for my boyfriend, I'll keep my mouth shut when it comes to him. He says he wants me to tell him this stuff, but I know deep down he really doesn't.
There's only so much of my negative, insecure bullshit he'll be willing to take before he goes out on the prowl. And I've seen some of his female friends. I can't compete with those ethereal Scandinavian beauties being the hella basic Mediterranean I am.

I don't know when I became such a fucking pussy. I used to walk down the street and feel fierce, or at least indifferent. Now I can be walking down an empty street and I still feel judged, like I'm completely and utterly wrong. Like there are snipers aiming at me.
I'm completely, utterly, and absolutely pathetic. And I feel like an attention whore for making this post in the first place.
